objects.name: Analytic 2281
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows host making outbound connections on HTTP/HTTPS/DNS ports to destinations outside the approved Industrial Control System (ICS) communication baseline, from processes that are not recognized Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor applications. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=3 on Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)/Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS)/Domain Name System (DNS) port from process not recognized as Industrial Control Systems (ICS) vendor application
